answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 35897 Country: India Title: Please let me know that is taking salary of government or personal holidays halal or haram? Question: Please let me know that is taking salary of government or personal holidays halal or haram? Answer ID: 35897 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 190/137/B=1433) If the government gives the salary of office days and the personal holidays then it is lawful to receive the salary of holidays. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
